title: How to Search for Jobs by Skills Instead of Job Titles
subtitle: A step-by-step masterclass on boolean skill querying, capability-based matching, and discovering lucrative cross-functional roles.
excerpt: Tired of repetitive search results? Learn how to structure skills-based search strings, use semantic AI tools, and target high-paying cross-industry roles tailored to your exact capabilities.
featuredImageAlt: Candidate analyzing technical skills matrix across diverse job sectors
author: Amarjot Lohia

sections.heading: The Rise of Skills-Based Hiring in 2026
sections.content:
The global labor market is experiencing a profound shift away from pedigree and rigid tenure toward demonstrable competency. According to recent talent surveys, over 72% of employers now prioritize verifiable skills over specific degree titles or previous linear job titles.

When you search by skills rather than titles, you uncover high-value hybrid roles that traditional search queries miss entirely.

sections.heading: How to Construct Advanced Boolean Skill Queries
sections.content:
When searching on conventional job boards or Google Jobs, use structured Boolean search operators to filter by capability stacks rather than title strings:

("Python" OR "TypeScript") AND ("PostgreSQL" OR "MongoDB") AND ("REST API" OR "GraphQL") -"Senior Manager"
("Product Analytics" OR "SQL" OR "Tableau") AND ("A/B Testing" OR "Conversion Rate") AND "Remote"

These queries return listings across Engineering, Product, Growth, and Data teams where your actual hands-on technical skills are in high demand.

sections.heading: Automated Skills Discovery with BuildAIResume
sections.content: Rather than manually writing complex Boolean strings every day, BuildAIResume's Discover Engine automatically analyzes your Master CV, extracts your hard and soft capability clusters, and queries thousands of fresh job postings in the background.

faqs.question: Can I use skills-based search for non-technical roles?
faqs.answer: Yes. Operations, sales, marketing, and HR roles benefit equally from searching by competency clusters (e.g., 'Pipeline Management', 'Contract Negotiation', 'SLA Optimization').
